style: Premium polished cozy 2.5D game asset for a seaside exploration town, children aged 8–12. High-end stylized 3D miniature, rounded hand-crafted shapes, convincing physical depth, layered ceramic tiles, wood grain and plaster material texture, painterly finish with crisp forms, rich warm light from upper left, soft ambient occlusion, sophisticated teal/coral/honey/ivory color palette. Clear readable silhouette at small game sizes. Entire object contained with 7% margin. assets.prompt: One beautiful fish-market cottage. Front door opens toward bottom center. Charming lively premium seaside shop.

One beautiful artisan aquarium-decoration workshop cottage. Warm cream plaster and timber framing, terracotta scalloped roof with a chimney, coral-red wooden front door, broad arched showcase windows displaying miniature castles, seashells and a planted terrarium, a tiny outdoor workbench with clay pots and paintbrushes, hanging brass lamps, purple wisteria and flower boxes. Front door toward bottom center. Elaborate cozy handmade architectural details.

One inviting harbor library building. Two-story creamy stone facade, mossy teal layered roof, elegant rounded central arched entrance, tall glowing mullioned windows showing shelves full of colorful books, round attic window, small decorative open-book emblem with NO letters, curved steps and carved wood railing, climbing ivy, rose planters and hanging brass lanterns. Compact readable seaside architectural charm.

One delightful child's aquarium cottage.
